high_level_description: This image is a highly detailed illustration of the Queen of Hearts from a playing card. The artwork is rich in color and intricate details, evoking a sense of fantasy and regality. Character: The central figure is a woman dressed as the Queen of Hearts. She has long, flowing red hair adorned with a large, ornate crown that features feathers and floral elements. Her attire includes a blue dress with gold accents and a white shawl draped over her shoulders. She holds a single red rose in her right hand, which is positioned near her chest.
